# flamin.go - Lightweight Automation Engine

## Value
Build fast, ship without friction. Dedicated micro-apps and automated creative growth systems designed for conversion and speed.

## Machine-to-Machine (M2M) Agentic Commerce API

### Product Catalog
Endpoint: GET /api/catalog.json
Schema Contract (exact 7 keys):
- id (string)
- name (string)
- price_cents (integer)
- currency ("USD")
- description (string)
- sample_output_url (string)
- checkout_type ("stripe_hosted" | "x402")

Products:
1. ad-concept-pack: 9900 cents ($99 USD), checkout_type: stripe_hosted
   Description: High-velocity ad concept generation system delivering creative angle variations, hook scripts, and audience targeting parameters for rapid performance testing.
2. visual-hook-matrix: 4900 cents ($49 USD), checkout_type: stripe_hosted
   Description: Structured visual hook library and retention scoring matrix designed for automated video and image ad creative synthesis pipelines.
3. micro-hook-query: 500 cents ($5 USD), checkout_type: x402
   Description: Programmatic single-query visual hook scoring and real-time creative angle generation over x402 micropayment rail.

### Agent Buy Endpoint
Endpoint: POST /api/agent/buy
Headers:
- Content-Type: application/json
- Idempotency-Key (optional, string): Prevents duplicate transactions
- X-Payment-Proof (optional, string): Settlement voucher for x402 rail

Flow:
- stripe_hosted: Returns HTTP 200 with checkout_url and X-Checkout-Type: stripe_hosted.
- x402 without payment proof: Returns HTTP 402 with WWW-Authenticate challenge, X-Payment-* headers, and invoice object.
- x402 with payment proof: Returns HTTP 200 with order confirmation and fulfillment access URL.

### Settlement Webhook
Endpoint: POST /api/agent/payments/webhook
Authentication: HMAC-SHA256 signature in X-Signature-SHA256 or X-Signature header over raw request body.
Safety Guardrail: Hard $20.00 USD (2000 cents) daily cap on programmatic settlements. Rejects excess requests with HTTP 429.
